answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one pearl weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, someone who spins up 103 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 30 times the capital for one share. The nebula report shows the merge explicitly at each shale. A farm of 4872 identities would post 2194 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
